description: Kailua Beach and Dune Management Plan is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Adaptation Knowledge Exchange (CAKE); University of Hawai'i Sea Grant. Kailua Beach is located on the windward (eastern) shore of the island of O‘ahu. While Kailua Beach is currently relatively stable, it is still at risk from a number of threats including overdevelopment and sea level rise. Coverage: Kailua Beach, Kailua, HI (2010). The toolkit gives Kailua Beach, Kailua, HI as the location, 2010 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
